sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco-based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. [1][2]

sources.title: GitHub - jev-ai/jev-ai: Jev AI · GitHub
sources.snippet: A decision model for software systems Jev AI is an online decision model for software teams that need structured answers from real-world application state. It is designed for the small but important decisions that happen repeatedly inside a product: classify a request, route a ticket, score urgency, check whether an action is safe, or decide whether a person should review the result.
